headline: GDX SURGES 4.5%, GOLD CLEARS $4,100 — JUNE PAYROLLS COLLAPSE KILLS FED RATE-HIKE BETS; BARRICK +4.1%, NEWMONT +3.8%, WHEATON +3.5%
snippet: Gold spot pushed through $4,100 and silver added 3.7% to $61.73 on July 2 after the U.S. economy created just 57,000 jobs in June — roughly half the 110,000 consensus — collapsing Fed rate-hike probability for September below 50% and sparking the biggest single-session gain for gold miners in months. The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) jumped 4.5%, Canada's TSX materials sector led broader market gains, and senior producers Barrick Mining +4.1%, Newmont +3.8%, and Wheaton Precious Metals +3.5% all outperformed the metal itself, signalling that institutional money is finally rotating into the equities rather than just bullion.

headline: CAMECO STAKES UP TO 57.4% AT CIGAR LAKE — C$115.75M TEPCO DEAL CLOSES, CONSOLIDATING WORLD'S HIGHEST-GRADE URANIUM MINE THROUGH 2036
snippet: Cameco Corp. (TSX:CCO) closed its acquisition of TEPCO Resources' 5% participating interest in the Cigar Lake Joint Venture on July 2, 2026, lifting Cameco's ownership to 57.418% and Orano's to 42.582% for a combined purchase price of approximately C$115.75 million. Cigar Lake in northern Saskatchewan carries proven and probable reserves of 172.4 million pounds of U3O8 at average grades approaching 15% — the world's highest-grade commercial uranium mine — and the deal extends Cameco's economic exposure through the mine's planned 2036 life horizon as global utility under-contracting continues to tighten the medium-term supply picture.

headline: WORLD GOLD COUNCIL CALLS IT 'POINT BREAK' — H2 2026 GOLD HINGES ON FED AND GEOPOLITICS; $4,100 BASE CASE BUT $4,500+ IF CONDITIONS SHIFT
snippet: The World Gold Council's mid-year 2026 gold outlook — titled "Point Break" — released July 1 finds gold at a critical H2 inflection point after a dramatic 23% intra-year range (January high $5,589/oz, June low sub-$4,000/oz), with the base case projecting a rangebound drift within ±5% of $4,100/oz through year-end under stable macro conditions. The WGC identifies three decisive variables for H2: the trajectory of Federal Reserve rate expectations (rate-hike risk is now falling), the durability of central bank gold demand, and whether institutional investors re-enter the market — any of which deteriorating could push gold decisively toward $4,500+ and favour a Q3 breakout.

headline: 42m AT 6.1% CuEq INCLUDING 9.8m AT 16.5% — FIREFLY'S GREEN BAY CONVERGENT CORE DELIVERS GRADE BOMB AHEAD OF JULY–AUGUST MRE (ASX/TSX:FFM)
snippet: FireFly Metals Ltd. (ASX/TSX:FFM) reported July 1 that infill drilling at the Green Bay copper-gold project in Newfoundland returned 42.0 metres at 6.1% copper equivalent — including 9.8 metres at 16.5% CuEq — in hole MUG26-053, and 51.5 metres at 4.9% CuEq in MUG26-054, where upper VMS lenses converge with a footwall stringer copper zone to produce exceptional composite grades. These results feed directly into a mid-year mineral resource estimate expected in July–August 2026, which will underpin a preliminary economic assessment for a potential upscaled mine restart at one of Atlantic Canada's most advanced copper-gold development assets.

headline: 757 g/t AgEq OVER 2.8m UNDERGROUND — SOUTHERN SILVER CHANNELS CONFIRM PURO CORAZON'S HIGH-GRADE POLYMETALLIC CORE AT CERRO LAS MINITAS (TSXV:SSV)
source_name: Resource World / Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV:SSV)
snippet: Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV:SSV) reported July 2 that underground channel sampling at the historic Puro Corazon Mine on the Cerro Las Minitas property in Durango, Mexico returned 2.8 metres averaging 757 g/t silver equivalent (305 g/t Ag, 1.2% Cu, 9.8% Pb, 6.7% Zn) and 3.2 metres averaging 479 g/t AgEq — confirming the high-grade polymetallic nerve of a small-scale historic producer that the company is integrating into a six-month drill campaign on the much larger Cerro Las Minitas project, which commenced mid-June. The results demonstrate grade continuity within a system that carries multiple potential mine types, from underground high-grade to broad bulk-tonnage mineralisation.

headline: FREEPORT PUTS C$15M BEHIND JOY DISTRICT — AMARC'S AURORA AND TWINS COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY TARGETS NOW DRILL-TESTING IN BC (TSXV:AHR)
snippet: Amarc Resources Ltd. (TSXV:AHR) announced July 2 that AuRORA Minerals Ltd. — the joint venture funded 60% by Freeport-McMoRan — has commenced its C$15 million 2026 field program at the JOY Copper-Gold District in north-central British Columbia, targeting step-out drilling at the AuRORA deposit (expanded to 1.4km × 0.8km in 2025 and still open in all directions) and first drill-testing of the TWINS copper-gold discovery 17 kilometres southeast within a highly prospective 8.5-km² sulphide system. The JOY District is emerging as one of BC's most active porphyry copper-gold districts with Freeport — the world's largest publicly traded copper producer — driving and funding the exploration program.

headline: CENTRAL BANKS RAMPED UP GOLD BUYING AGAIN IN MAY — SOVEREIGN ACCUMULATION ACCELERATES AS GOLD CORRECTS FROM JANUARY'S $5,589 HIGH
snippet: Money Metals' July 2 analysis of World Gold Council data confirms that central bank gold purchases accelerated again in May 2026, with emerging market sovereign institutions expanding reserves on the price dip even as Western retail investors sold. The analysis frames this divergence as a defining structural signal: the same central banks that drove 2024–2025's record buying are treating the January–June correction as a multi-year accumulation opportunity, not a trend change — a pattern historically associated with price floors rather than breakdowns, and one that supports the WGC's $4,100 base-case for H2 2026.

headline: LI-FT DRILLS 21m AT 1.09% Li2O IN BIG — SPODUMENE PEGMATITE DYKES CONFIRMED ACROSS 100m CORRIDORS AT YELLOWKNIFE RESOURCE GROWTH ZONE (TSXV:LIFT)
source_name: North of 60 Mining News / Li-FT Power Ltd. (TSXV:LIFT)
snippet: Li-FT Power Ltd. (TSXV:LIFT) reported winter drill results showing the BIG area of the Yellowknife Lithium Project in NWT hosts multiple spodumene-bearing pegmatite dykes across 100-metre-wide corridors — including 21 metres at 1.09% Li2O at the Fi Main zone (hole YLP-0304) and cumulative composite widths of 28–33 metres in adjacent step-out holes — marking the first systematic drilling in BIG since the existing 50.4 million tonne inferred resource at 1.0% Li2O was defined. North of 60 Mining News covered the results on July 3, highlighting that the BIG footprint could substantially expand the resource when incorporated into the next estimate.

headline: SELKIRK TARGETS MID-2028 MINTO RESTART — PEA AND MRE DUE THIS MONTH; 87% DRILL HIT RATE AT COPPER MINE BOUGHT FROM BANKRUPTCY FOR C$16M (TSXV:SCMI)
source_name: Crux Investor / Selkirk Copper Mines Inc. (TSXV:SCMI)
snippet: Crux Investor profiled Selkirk Copper Mines Inc. (TSXV:SCMI) on July 2, highlighting that Phase 1 drilling (175 holes) at the Minto copper-gold-silver mine in Yukon achieved an 87% hit rate and discovered two previously unknown mineral lenses, building on a 881-million-pound copper resource base. An updated PEA and mineral resource estimate are due in July 2026, underpinning a targeted 12-to-15-year integrated open-pit/underground mine at ~30,000 tonnes CuEq per year — a potential restart at an asset Selkirk acquired out of Capstone Mining's bankruptcy for C$16 million against an estimated C$300 million in prior construction spend; a feasibility study is expected to begin in late August 2026.

headline: SILVER'S CORRECTION IS OVER — ANALYST SAYS ACCUMULATE ON DIPS AS TECHNICAL OVERSOLD EXTREMES HIT PRIOR BULL-MARKET BUY ZONES
snippet: Published July 1 as silver traded between $57–60 following its sharpest correction since early 2025, a Money Metals technical analysis argues the six-month decline from above $70 to below $55 constitutes a standard bull-market retracement rather than a trend reversal — with momentum indicators reaching oversold readings historically consistent with accumulation zones — and that the structural silver deficit of 46+ million ounces per year provides a durable fundamental floor. The thesis received early validation when the weak June jobs report triggered silver's 3.7% jump on July 2, pushing it decisively back above $60; the analyst sees further upside potential in H2 2026 for investors who accumulated during the correction.
